[EN] Thulsa's scouts have us surrounded, and it's just a matter of time before more of Thulsa's minions show up.

Unless we strike first.

, repel the scout brigade and show them we won't give up ground without a fight!
[ES] Los exploradores de Thulsa nos tienen rodeados, y es solo cuestión de tiempo antes de que aparezcan más esbirros de Thulsa.

A menos que strike first.

, ¡repeliere a la brigada de exploradores y demuéstrales que no cederemos terreno sin dar pelea!

[EN] You've not only saved Habere from Thulsa, but I think you just opened a supply route to the Remote Lodge, . Thanks!
[ES] No solo has salvado a Habere de Thulsa, sino que creo que acabas de abrir una ruta de suministro al Remote Lodge, . ¡Gracias!
